acceptance.given: A package declares a secret-using capability without a named runtime credential owner and is submitted to the normal validator entry point.

oracle.expected: Validation fails with a diagnostic identifying the missing runtime credential owner and applicable A15 rule, without exposing credential values.
forbidden: Validation succeeds despite the missing runtime credential owner.
The diagnostic exposes a credential value or synthetic secret marker beyond allowed location and rule information.
oracle.observable: A pytest case invokes scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package or its main CLI on a disposable package missing the runtime credential owner and inspects the structured result and diagnostic.

acceptance.then: The validator returns a failed result whose diagnostic identifies the missing runtime credential owner and rule while redacting secret content.
acceptance.when: During runtime validation, the validator checks the secret-using capability declaration for a named runtime credential owner.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject secret-using capability declarations that omit the runtime credential owner and report only the location and applicable rule.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema migration; rollback removes the new validator implementation.

slice_hint.state_transition: A secret-using capability lacking a runtime credential owner transitions from validation input to a failed validation result with an A15 diagnostic.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The A15 test selector and applicable capability regression module pass, with the result asserting failure, rule/location reporting, and absence of credential content.
